SECTION 3 (Resources and Techniques) describes how the LSA model is built: term‑term vectors are derived from corpora, dimensionality reduction via singular‑value decomposition is applied, and cosine similarity is used to compute the similarity between an MWE and its constituents. SECTION 4 (Evaluation) shows how the model’s similarity scores are used to rank MWEs and evaluate correlation with WordNet hyponymy, thereby demonstrating that the LSA‑based similarity serves as the predictive component of the empirical model. Together these sections provide a complete description of the empirical model that predicts MWE decomposability using LSA.
